dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Of course! Any time, anywhere, any place! For however long you like...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I'm always happy to lend an ear!

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Although, there is something I wanted to ask, now that I've seen this masterpiece...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: As you get further on your journey... Will you change the look of this place?

choices.text: Change the look of this place?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Well, let's say you make your way to... Snezhnaya, and the aesthetic catches your eye. Would you try to recreate it here?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Or, say that you make a new friend. Would you decorate a portion of this Realm to make them feel at home?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I do like to introduce new things from my journey...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: I see. That makes a lot of sense...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Then, I suppose... there could be a few surprises in store one day. I'll look forward to it.

choices.text: Hmm... I don't think there's really a need?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is a place of freedom and relaxation.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: You've got a point. There's a lesson in there somewhere... Don't get hung up on the little things. It can be much easier to relax that way...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: You have a knack for putting people at ease, and the way you designed this place reflects that... It's wonderful to be here.
